mil3.3.13:0.3: The Question on the Mark of Thought
mil3.3.13:1.1: “Venerable Nagasena, what is the mark of thought?”
mil3.3.13:1.2: “Thought is without a mark, Great King.”
mil3.3.13:2.2: “Just as, Great King, a carpenter smooths a well-wrought plank with his plane;
mil3.3.13:2.3: so too, Great King, thought is without a mark.”
mil3.3.13:4.1: The Question on the Mark of Thought: Thirteenth.
